mainEntity.name: How much does AI SEO typically cost for an automotive dealership?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO for an automotive dealership can vary widely, typically ranging from a few hundred dollars to several thousand dollars per month, depending on the scope of services and the provider. Factors influencing the price include the dealership's size, the competitiveness of its local market, the breadth of AI tools utilized (e.g., content generation, technical SEO, reputation management), and the level of dedicated support. Some providers offer tiered packages, while others customize solutions based on specific needs. It's essential to get a detailed proposal outlining all included services and expected outcomes.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO for dealerships typically costs from a few hundred to several thousand dollars monthly, varying with dealership size, market competitiveness, scope of AI tools, and level of support.
